code_findings.title: In ChatGoogle.ainvoke, whenever self.thinking_budget is non-None—including explicitly supplied 0 or positive values—the generated request config uses thinking_budget=-1 instead of the supplied value.
code_findings.explanation: The condition accepts every non-None integer, but the assigned configuration value is the literal -1. The resulting config is passed to generate_content. The diff shows this was changed from using self.thinking_budget, so this change directly causes explicit values to be discarded during request serialization.
code_findings.impact: Caused by the change: The changed assignment replaced {'thinking_budget': self.thinking_budget} with {'thinking_budget': -1}. Consequently, any non-None caller value passes the guard but is replaced by -1 before config is sent to the provider.
